about_the_game:
Many dreamed as children of setting up an off-road track on their own desk and conquering it with their favorite vehicle. Now this dream has come true! This game offers a unique opportunity to immerse yourself in the world of off-road driving right on your desk at a 1:20 scale.

  • You have several off-road vehicles to choose from, each with its own characteristics, strengths, and weaknesses.

  • Customize and personalize each off-road vehicle to suit your preferences.

  • Multiple levels filled with challenging tests

  • Realistic physics and a unique simulation system for tire friction against the surface

  • Beautiful graphics that make you believe it all happens right before your eyes on your desk

Little Offroad Adventures is not just a game—it's an exciting adventure that takes your breath away and brings endless joy!
